# Owen Ford

## Overview

- **Age:** 30 to 35 years old  <sub>[v4 c24 P4](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 c22 P21](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0021)</sub>
- **Origin:** Ontario  <sub>[v4 c22 P20](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0020)</sub>
- **Role:** Journalist and author  <sub>[v4 c22 P20](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0020), [v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023)</sub>

## Appearance

Owen is a tall, broad-shouldered, and remarkably handsome man with fine features. He has a finely-cut nose and chin, thick brown hair, and large, brilliant dark-gray eyes. His face carries a slightly sad, thoughtful expression when unsmiling, but lights up with a warm, charming smile.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P10](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0010)_

## Personality

Owen possesses a deeply sensitive, imaginative, and artistic nature, keenly appreciative of beauty, charm, and storytelling. Though generally friendly, articulate, and well-dressed, his unsmiling countenance carries an undertone of melancholy and past hardship. He is deeply honorable and conscientious, refusing to compromise his integrity or cause pain even when faced with overwhelming personal anguish. When captivated by an idea or a romance, he throws himself into it with passionate intensity and devotion.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P10](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0010), [v4 c25 P11](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0011), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c26 P11](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0011), [v4 c26 P13](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0013)_

## History

Owen Ford came to Four Winds to recuperate after a severe attack of typhoid fever, boarding at the house of Leslie Moore. Upon his arrival, he met Anne and Gilbert Blythe, who introduced him to Captain Jim Boyd at the Four Winds Light. Discovering Captain Jim's logbook of sea-faring adventures, Owen recognized its immense narrative value and decided to collaborate with the old captain to write a novel based on his life. Throughout the summer, he worked on the manuscript at the lighthouse, forming a deep friendship with Captain Jim, Anne, and Leslie. During this time, he fell intensely in love with Leslie, but kept his feelings concealed when he believed she was bound irrevocably to her incapacitated husband, Dick Moore. After completing his novel, Owen confessed his love to Anne before departing Four Winds, believing he would never see Leslie again. Later, when it was revealed through a surgical operation that Leslie's husband was actually his deceased cousin George, Leslie became a free woman. Upon learning of her freedom, Owen returned to Four Winds, declared his love to Leslie in Anne's garden, and became engaged to her. He eventually purchased the little house of dreams to serve as their summer home, and his book, The Life-Book of Captain Jim, was published to great critical and commercial acclaim.

_Sources: [v4 c22 P20](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0020), [v4 c23 P10](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0010), [v4 c24 P21](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0021), [v4 c25 P0](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0000), [v4 c25 P5](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0005), [v4 c25 P11](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0011), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c26 P19](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0019), [v4 c31 P19](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0019), [v4 c38 P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009), [v4 c39 P0](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Grandson of John Selwyn, the schoolmaster who built the house of dreams, and his bride, Persis Leigh  <sub>[v4 c22 P20](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0020), [v4 c23 P10](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0010), [v4 c24 P22](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0022)</sub>
- Son of Alice Selwyn  <sub>[v4 c24 P22](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0022)</sub>
- Worked as a newspaper man and magazine short-story writer in Toronto  <sub>[v4 c22 P20](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0020), [v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023)</sub>
- Suffered a severe bout of typhoid fever prior to coming to Four Winds  <sub>[v4 c22 P20](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0020)</sub>
